description: On-chain hierarchical agent registry on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.32). An admin initialises a registry PDA (seeds ["registry"]), then registers a root agent (seeds ["agent", wallet]). Child spawn and earnings distribution were not exercised in this run.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration on the Blockchains/hydra fork. The lab only changed declare_id to the Sol.College devnet program. The hosted IDL is a hand-derived subset covering the verified initialize and register_root_agent instructions; discriminators were confirmed on-chain. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; fixes are offered upstream as ordinary pull requests and acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness on the Solana runtime (initialize, register_root_agent)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/hydra/
QA: devnet proof of initialize, register_root_agent campus-scout, and NameTooLong
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Exercise spawn_child and a simple earning distribution on the lab registry
